if ! ./configure; then
    cat configure.log
    exit 1
fi

make -j$(nproc) clean
make -j$(nproc) all

for f in $(find $SRC -name '*_fuzzer.c'); do
    b=$(basename -s .c $f)
    $CC $CFLAGS -I. $f -c -o /tmp/$b.o
    $CXX $CXXFLAGS -o $OUT/$b /tmp/$b.o -stdlib=libc++ $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE ./libz.a
    rm -f /tmp/$b.o
    ln -sf $OUT/seed_corpus.zip $OUT/${b}_seed_corpus.zip
done

dependency_reason: Supplies the bound used to size the compression buffer.
Shows the relevant deflate input and output guards.
Shows deflateEnd's state check and deallocation.
